title: A first term of Greek classics
description: Begin with a homecoming, then two very different visions of the Greek stage.
scope: The three whole works assigned in translation before arrival in Balliol’s July 2026 guidance. This is a specific preparation sequence, not the Oxford degree or every Mods assignment.

items.title: The Odyssey
items.note: Read the whole poem in translation; Greek-language preparation additionally specifies books 9 and 12.

items.title: Bacchae
items.note: Read Bacchae, not the other plays in this volume. Greek preparation specifies lines 1–368.

items.title: Lysistrata
items.note: Read Lysistrata, not the entire collected edition. Greek preparation specifies lines 1–253.

title: Eastern classics: an introduction
description: Follow a route through ethical questions, spiritual inquiry, and the literature of everyday life.
scope: Nine Atlas-selected entry points from the published program. This shorter route is our adaptation; the college’s own public list is also selective.

items.title: Analects
items.note: Short conversations reward slow reading; keep track of recurring ideas about conduct.

items.title: Mencius
items.note: Compare the arguments about human nature with the Analects.

items.title: The Book of Chuang Tzu
items.note: Read the parables as challenges to familiar distinctions.

items.title: Tao Te Ching
items.note: Try a few chapters at a time and compare their language.

items.title: The Bhagavad Gita
items.note: A dialogue about action and obligation within a much larger epic.

items.title: The Lotus Sutra
items.note: Catalog match pending; consult the program source.

items.title: The Tale of the Heike
items.note: Follow the changing fortunes of families and political power.

items.title: The Pillow Book
items.note: Read lists and observations alongside the longer narrative works.

items.title: The Tale of Genji
items.note: Allow a longer reading period and use the edition’s character guide.

description: Move from epic journeys to questions of knowledge, community and spiritual life.

items.note: Catalog match pending.
